# Telling the product director real-time sync would not work

Situation: A few months into a partner integration I found that the partner's API rate limits
made real-time sync impossible for our largest customers, after the product director had already
announced it to them.

Task: Deliver the bad news quickly and leave her with a plan she could take to customers.

Action: I asked for fifteen minutes the same day, opened with the conclusion, showed the rate
limit math, and brought two options I had already worked through: near-real-time with a five
minute delay for large accounts, or real-time for a subset of the data.

Result: She chose the five minute delay and told the customers herself with a clear story. The
conversation was uncomfortable but short, because it came with options and not only a problem.
